topics.label: Introduction to cancer biology and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture series, outlines the course objectives, and presents the key learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cellular differentiation failure and models of cancer biology
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how accumulated genetic and epigenetic alterations lead to a breakdown of normal tissue architecture and cellular differentiation, and discuss experimental approaches to studying these processes.

topics.label: Characteristics of tumor invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: They define the distinction between benign and malignant tumors based on local tissue invasion and the routes and consequences of metastatic spread.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and the behavior of benign lesions
topics.groupedBecause: They illustrate the stepwise progression from benign adenomas to invasive carcinomas using colorectal cancer as an example and discuss the clinical complications benign tumors can cause.

topics.label: Conventions and exceptions in tumor nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the standardized naming rules for benign and malignant tumors based on tissue origin and highlights key exceptions to these rules.

topics.label: Pathophysiological mechanisms of cancer disease and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the local and systemic mechanisms by which primary and metastatic tumors cause clinical illness and patient death.

topics.label: Incidence of cancer across human tissues and animal taxa
topics.groupedBecause: They compare the frequency and mortality of different tumor types in humans and analyze cancer occurrence across companion animals and other multicellular species.

topics.label: Principles and modalities of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the rationale for population screening and compare the diagnostic approaches and effectiveness of screening for cervical, colorectal, breast, and prostate cancers.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical session preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture by reiterating the learning outcomes and looking ahead to the upcoming practicals and next lecture.
